scripts.dev: bun run train && bun run --parallel --filter "*" dev
scripts.build: bun run train && bun run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: bun run train && tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.check: bun run check:rust && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run train && bun run check:prepared
scripts.train: bun run build:packages && bun run train:filters && bun run train:neural
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:rust && bun run build:core && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/train build && bun run --filter matchbox-ai build
scripts.train:neural: bun run matchbox train examples/sketch && bun run matchbox train examples/is-even && bun run matchbox train examples/money && bun run matchbox train examples/time && bun run matchbox train tests/fixtures/field-classifier && bun run matchbox train tests/fixtures/recurrent-classifier
scripts.check:prepared: tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter "*" typecheck && bun test ./tests && bun run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/playground build && bun run --filter @matchbox-ai/benchmarks build
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && bun install --lockfile-only && bun run format
scripts.check:rust: bun scripts/rust.ts cargo fmt --all --check && bun scripts/rust.ts cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun scripts/rust.ts cargo test -p matchbox-engine --features training --all-targets
